detail: The official Hillingdon ArcGIS layer metadata exposes Listed Buildings as esriGeometryPoint with REFERENCE/easting/northing fields. Strict producer schema forbids Point as source-area or parcel geometry. The point-only candidate was rejected from records.geojson. Only the official layer coverage envelope was materialized as a source-area Polygon. No matched TOID/UPRN, actual building polygon, canonical_parcel_id, or elevation statistic was fabricated.
